parsed.explanation: No trans-presentation offence is documented and identifying as non-binary was excluded from the Act, but the upheld Act imposes 20 years and death for aggravated same-sex conduct and is actively enforced through arrests, shelter raids, neighbour reporting, invasive examinations and documented digital entrapment as a main police tactic. A trans woman was mobbed into a coma in 2024, state and community leaders incite violence, and impunity and public outing are documented. A visitor outed as gender-nonconforming or assumed homosexual faces imprisonment, extortion, custody abuse or mob violence with no effective remedy. One 2021 identity document does not mitigate visitor exposure.

entry_documents.protection: One trans woman received female identity documents in 2021; resident-facing only and not a visitor document regime.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented border rejection, marker rule or document-mismatch practice for foreign passports.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented arrests, shelter raids and 2021 raid with 44 arrests and alleged invasive anal examinations; Feb 2026 arrest after neighbour report.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Outing or neighbour/digital report can lead to raid, detention and invasive examination; custody placement for trans visitors not documented.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: No documented bathroom, ward or facility rule; absence is not evidence of safety.

care_services.interaction: No documented trans-specific emergency care, medication or ward practice for visitors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Act upheld Apr 2024: death for aggravated homosexuality, 20 years for homosexuality/attempt, 10 years marriage provisions; digital entrapment is a main tactic.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Proposed 10-year offence for identifying as gay/non-binary was excluded; trans identity itself is not documented as a standalone offence.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Sexuality law is documented as an active police lever through raids, arrests and app entrapment, not a dead letter, raising risk for visibly gender-nonconforming visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: Aggravated category includes sex with a person under 18 and carries death penalty; minors convicted of homosexuality face 3 years.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor does not create protection; an allegation involving a minor escalates exposure for adult and minor.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Jan 2024 trans woman mobbed into two-week coma after false video; harassment and attacks incited or performed by state officials, climate of impunity, historical outing and 2011 activist murder.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Mob and official incitement compound police exposure; no documented prosecution or protection for trans victims.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Constitutional Court upheld core Act; people in hiding, forced online self-concealment, no documented effective remedy for raids, outing or violence.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Custody placement, facilities, care, visitor arrest frequency and trans-specific killing rates remain unknown and are not treated as safe.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in active use of general morality law for raids, detention, impunity and state/religious hostility, but this dossier does not document trans visitors arrested on sight, birth-sex custody sexual assault, or deaths, so it is not shown as severe as 0.15-E.

Similar organised police raids, outing, extortion/impunity and state threat-framing, but exposure is more severe because the enforced law carries 20 years and death in aggravated cases and a trans woman was beaten into a coma, placing it below 0.25.

0.35-C has police stops and payments without a capital/20-year enforced sexuality regime or documented mob coma and state-incited violence; this dossier has a materially harsher operative law and documented enforcement, so it rates well below 0.35.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime is national and actively enforced: neighbour reports, raids and app entrapment can out a visitor, after which the upheld Act, official incitement and impunity expose them to long imprisonment, invasive custody practices, extortion and mob violence. The exclusion of a trans-identity offence and one resident identity document are limited mitigations that do not counter the documented enforcement lever. Facilities, care and custody outcomes are undocumented, not safe.
